data.name: Mahdiya
data.gender_notes: Mahdiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahdiya is an Arabic name that means 'guided one' or 'rightly guided'. It is a name that symbolizes spiritual guidance and direction in life. The name Mahdiya carries the meaning “Guided One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahdiya usually hope their child will grow to embody guided one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahdiya is associated with the concept of guidance and righteousness, as mentioned in the Quran (2:120).
data.etymology: Mahdiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guided One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahdiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: المهدية
in_arabic.meaning: من يهدي الله تعالى ويتبع طريق الحق والهداية
in_arabic.long_meaning: المهدية هي من أسماء الإناث في الإسلام، مشتقة من الفعل هدي، وتعني الشخص الذي يهديه الله تعالى لطريق الحق والهداية. ورد اسم المهدية في بعض المصادر الإسلامية كوصف للشخص الذي يتلقى الهداية من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: مہدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس کی ہدایت اللہ تعالیٰ کرتا ہے اور حق کا راستہ دکھاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہدیہ ایک عورت کا نام ہے جو اسلامی ناموں میں شامل ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کی ہدایت اللہ تعالیٰ کرتا ہے اور اسے حق کا راستہ دکھاتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں اس کا تعلق ہدایت اور رہنمائی کے تصور سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मेहदिया
in_hindi.meaning: जिसकी अल्लाह द्वारा हिदायत की जाती है और सच्चाई का रास्ता दिखाया जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मेहदिया एक महिला का नाम है जो इस्लामी नामों में शामिल है। इसका अर्थ है जिसकी अल्लाह द्वारा हिदायत की जाती है और सच्चाई का रास्ता दिखाया जाता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से निकला है, जहां इसका संबंध हिदायत और मार्गदर्शन की अवधारणा से है।

in_pashto.name: مهديہ
in_pashto.meaning: هغه څوک چې د الله تعالی لخوا هدایت کیږي او د حق لاره ښودل کیږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهديہ د ښځو یو نوم دی چې په اسلامي نومونو کې شامل دی. دا پدې معنی ده چې هغه څوک چې د الله تعالی لخوا هدایت کیږي او د حق لاره ښودل کیږي. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرته چې د هدایت او لارښوونې مفهوم سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Mahdiya
in_english.meaning: One who is guided by Allah and follows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Mahdiya is a feminine name in Islamic tradition, derived from the Arabic root 'h-d-y', which means 'to guide'. It refers to a person who is guided by Allah and follows the right path. This name has significant spiritual connotations, implying a state of being divinely guided towards righteousness and truth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahdiya has historical and cultural significance in Islamic tradition as it is associated with the belief in the coming of the Mahdi, an expected messianic figure who is believed to bring justice, peace, and prosperity to the world. The name Mahdiya is not only used as a personal name, but it is also given to places and institutions that are associated with the Mahdi or his teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mahdiya holds great spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the importance of guidance and direction in life. It is believed that the Mahdi will provide spiritual guidance to the world and lead people towards the right path. The name Mahdiya is a symbol of hope, illumination, and enlightenment. It is a name that inspires individuals to seek spiritual growth, and to follow the righteous path in their lives, towards achieving inner peace and fulfillment.
